name: Hydraulic cylinders and pumps
summary: Oil-filled jacks, cylinders and pumps that lift tonnes with hand force.
uses: Rams for home-built presses, lifts and log splitters
identify: Bottle jacks, floor jacks, engine cranes, pallet jacks and log splitters each hold a cylinder and a pump. Tractors, tail lifts, dump trailers and lifts have long cylinders with hoses. Polished chrome rods and hoses with crimped ends give them away.
test: Pump a jack under a light load and leave it: it should hold without sinking. Never get under a load held only by a jack, and feel for leaks with cardboard, not your hand: a pinhole jet can inject oil into skin.

decay.note: Cylinders last; seals harden and exposed rods rust, but both can be rebuilt.
